python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Treasury data (in millions of dollars)
# June 1991
europe_1991 = 268166
latin_america_1991 = 337565

# June 1996
europe_1996 = 426245
latin_america_1996 = 443872

# Linear regression with Europe as predictor of Latin America
# We have two points, so it's a line through both points
slope = (latin_america_1996 - latin_america_1991) / (europe_1996 - europe_1991)
intercept = latin_america_1991 - slope * europe_1991

print(f"Linear Regression:")
print(f"  Slope: {slope}")
print(f"  Intercept: {intercept}")
print()

# Germany's nominal GDP (World Bank) - in billions
germany_gdp_1991 = 1875.79
germany_gdp_1996 = 2506.58

# Germany's percentage growth rate
germany_growth_rate = (germany_gdp_1996 - germany_gdp_1991) / germany_gdp_1991
print(f"Germany GDP growth rate: {germany_growth_rate * 100:.2f}%")

# Counterfactual: Apply Germany's growth rate to June 1991 Europe value
counterfactual_europe = europe_1991 * (1 + germany_growth_rate)
print(f"Counterfactual Europe (June 1991 + Germany growth): {counterfactual_europe:.2f}")

# Predict corresponding Latin America value using regression
predicted_latin_america = slope * counterfactual_europe + intercept
print(f"Predicted Latin America (counterfactual): {predicted_latin_america:.2f}")

# Calculate absolute difference from actual June 1996 Latin America value
absolute_difference = latin_america_1996 - predicted_latin_america
print(f"Absolute difference: {absolute_difference:.2f}")

# Express as percentage of actual June 1996 value
percentage_of_actual = (absolute_difference / latin_america_1996) * 100
print(f"Percentage of actual: {percentage_of_actual:.2f}%")

# U.S. total liabilities growth (Europe + Latin America & Caribbean as proxy)
total_liabilities_1991 = europe_1991 + latin_america_1991
total_liabilities_1996 = europe_1996 + latin_america_1996
us_liabilities_growth_ratio = total_liabilities_1996 / total_liabilities_1991
print(f"\nU.S. total liabilities (Europe + Latin America):")
print(f"  1991: {total_liabilities_1991}")
print(f"  1996: {total_liabilities_1996}")
print(f"  Growth ratio: {us_liabilities_growth_ratio:.4f}")

# Ratio of U.S. total liabilities growth to Germany's GDP growth
ratio = us_liabilities_growth_ratio / (1 + germany_growth_rate)
print(f"Ratio (US liabilities growth / Germany GDP growth): {ratio:.4f}")

# Final calculation
final_result = percentage_of_actual * ratio
print(f"\nFinal Result: {final_result:.2f}")

# Round to 2 decimal places
print(f"\nRounded to 2 decimal places: {round(final_result, 2)}")
EOF
